title: Fix numeric overflow
description: This closes #14 by fixing a potential numeric overflow during some integer arithmetic.

title: Knn dp
description:
Hi Thomas, 

I made several significant improvements of the densityClust algorithm by using kNN to calculate the local density and distance to another sample with higher density. The current implementation can handle 100, 000 sample (100k X 2 tSNE dimensions) in about 15 minutes. It can accept input of the coordinates of large datasets instead of the distance matrix because it will be insanely large for a dataset including 100 k samples. Could you please merge the change? Since we want to release another bioconductor package soon which depends on this package,  I hope you could help us merge it sooner. Thanks in advance.

title: update for dealing with big dataset (size_t, remove conversion from distance to matrix) and verbose for running details, etc.
description:
I have made the following changes to enable the package to deal with big dataset (tested on about 70k samples): 
1. replace int with size_t to declare variable in Rcpp 
2. remove the conversion from dist object to matrix in findClusters.densityCluster 
3. added a findDistValueByRowColInd function writen in Rcpp to accelerate the access of elements in the dist object mentioned above 
4. add verbose for some functions for printing running information and enable findClusters.densityCluster to accept a vector of index as the density peaks 
5. added new code in test.that for testing the findDistValueByRowColInd function

title: added plotDensityClust function
description: This PR adds `plotDensityClust`, which produces a panel of up to three diagnostic functions in ggplot2 with appropriate labelling and color coding for clusters.

title: add plotDensityClust & cluster sorting by gamma
description:
Added function to use ggplot to create 1-3 part panel of decision graph, gamma graph, and/or MDS plot
Added code in findClusters to sort cluster numbers by gamma (rho * delta)

title: Sorting clusters, finding k peaks, new plots
description:
I've changed the findClusters function to
 1) have the options of finding the top 'k' peaks based on gamma value
 2) sort clusters based on peak gamma value

I've also added some different plotting functions for the three main kinds of plots (decision, gamma, and MDS graphs), along with one that combines all three.

title: Simple efficiency improvement
description:
Hej Thomas

Changing this line of code makes `densityClust()` run 2-3X faster while giving identical results. The details are below, but profiling showed that `estimateDc()` was taking the most time and I figured out a more efficient way to do the same calculation. See https://gist.github.com/seaaan/8120969164b5e51185af for how I measured performance.

God weekend! 

---

Current implementation:
1. Create logical matrix for comb < dc
2. Calculate vector of row sums
3. Subtract 1 from each element of row-sum vector
4. Divide each element of row-sum vector by size
5. Calculate the mean of the row-sum vector

Improved implementation:
1. Create logical matrix for comb < dc
2. Calculate matrix sum (scalar)
3. Divide matrix sum by number of rows of matrix to get mean (scalar)
4. Subtract 1 from mean
5. Divide mean by size

~2-3 fold speedup. See https://gist.github.com/seaaan/8120969164b5e51185af for profiling results.

title: Refactor and document further
description: Everything works as before, with a few changes to some of the function names, namely `densityClust()` to `dclust()` (to avoid clashes with the package name) and `estimateDc()` to `estimateDC()` for consistent case. In addition to extra document (and typo fixes), a CITATION file is provided.
